name: contract-shape-catalogue
claim: Contract rules decompose into a closed registry of interpretable kinds, each with a Datalog fact shape, an Elixir interpreter module, and required fields per rule entry
invariants: Every contract with non-empty rules must have a kind matching one entry in this catalogue
Each kind has exactly one interpreter module
The catalogue is closed: new kinds require updating this contract

evidence.detail: Added the output-target kind to the closed catalogue: rules are singleton field maps (output_path/header_comment/render_sections, or entry/render_steps for codepath targets), interpreted by CB.OutputTarget; per-shape required fields are enforced by the interpreter per tag, so required_rule_fields is empty. Closes the gap opened when b042 (CLAUDE.md) introduced the kind without updating the catalogue.

Accepted via human adjudication against cb:b035. Reasoning: b035's own invariant says new rule kinds require updating this contract; output-target contracts (b042, codepath render-specs) have carried non-empty rules outside the catalogue since 2026-06-07. The catalogue is closed by supersession, exactly as it prescribes.

Grounding added under the b059 carve-out collapse: the catalogue was the last active contract standing alone. Its adoption record - the plan-3 batch that minted it as b035's successor - is promoted from the 2026-06-09 evidence entry to the node's stipulation artifact.
